verses.text: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, in You I have taken refuge; Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.textZh: （大衛指著便雅憫人古實的話，向耶和華唱的流離歌。）耶和華─我的神啊，我投靠你！求你救我脫離一切追趕我的人，將我救拔出來！

verses.text: Or he will tear my soul like a lion, Dragging me away, while there is none to deliver.
verses.textZh: 恐怕他們像獅子撕裂我，甚至撕碎，無人搭救。

verses.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this, If there is injustice in my hands,
verses.textZh: 耶和華─我的神啊，我若行了這事，若有罪孽在我手裡，

verses.text: If I have rewarded evil to my friend, Or have plundered him who without cause was my adversary,
verses.textZh: 我若以惡報那與我交好的人─連那無故與我為敵的，我也救了他，

verses.text: Let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake [it]; And let him trample my life down to the ground And lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
verses.textZh: 就任憑仇敵追趕我，直到追上，將我的性命踏在地下，使我的榮耀歸於灰塵。（細拉）

verses.text: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; Lift up Yourself against the rage of my adversaries, And arouse Yourself for me; You have appointed judgment.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你在怒中起來，挺身而立，抵擋我敵人的暴怒！求你為我興起！你已經命定施行審判！

verses.text: Let the assembly of the peoples encompass You, And over them return on high.
verses.textZh: 願眾民的會環繞你！願你從其上歸於高位！

verses.text: The LORD judges the peoples; Vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and my integrity that is in me.
verses.textZh: 耶和華向眾民施行審判；耶和華啊，求你按我的公義和我心中的純正判斷我。

verses.text: O let the evil of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; For the righteous God tries the hearts and minds.
verses.textZh: 願惡人的惡斷絕！願你堅立義人！因為公義的神察驗人的心腸肺腑。

verses.text: My shield is with God, Who saves the upright in heart.
verses.textZh: 神是我的盾牌；他拯救心裡正直的人。

verses.text: God is a righteous judge, And a God who has indignation every day.
verses.textZh: 神是公義的審判者，又是天天向惡人發怒的神。

verses.text: If a man does not repent, He will sharpen His sword; He has bent His bow and made it ready.
verses.textZh: 若有人不回頭，他的刀必磨快，弓必上弦，預備妥當了。

verses.text: He has also prepared for Himself deadly weapons; He makes His arrows fiery shafts.
verses.textZh: 他也預備了殺人的器械；他所射的是火箭。

verses.text: Behold, he travails with wickedness, And he conceives mischief and brings forth falsehood.
verses.textZh: 試看惡人因奸惡而劬勞，所懷的是毒害，所生的是虛假。

verses.text: He has dug a pit and hollowed it out, And has fallen into the hole which he made.
verses.textZh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了，竟掉在自己所挖的阱裡。

verses.text: His mischief will return upon his own head, And his violence will descend upon his own pate.
verses.textZh: 他的毒害必臨到他自己的頭上；他的強暴必落到他自己的腦袋上。

verses.text: I will give thanks to the LORD according to His righteousness And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
verses.textZh: 我要照著耶和華的公義稱謝他，歌頌耶和華至高者的名。
